title: Core: Renderer - SymbolInstance rendering (nested symbol)
description: Unit tests for SymbolInstance rendering in the canvas renderer. A SymbolInstance on stage should recursively render its symbol's timeline at the correct transform. Find the renderer, test that a SymbolInstance pointing to a symbol with shapes causes the renderer to draw those shapes with the instance's transform applied. Tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/symbol-render.test.ts.
